title: Have/get something done; want something done
summary: Конструкции **have / get + объект + V3** (услуга, неприятность, «успеть сделать») и **want / need + объект + V3**.
ru:
## Have something done: услуга или неприятность
Конструкция **have + объект + V3** описывает ситуацию, когда действие выполняет **кто-то другой**, а не подлежащее. Это может быть:
- **услуга** (мы заказываем или оплачиваем): > We're **having the roof repaired**. — Нам чинят крышу. > Where do you **have your hair cut**? — Где ты стрижёшься?
- **неприятное событие** (что-то случилось с вами): > She **had her bag stolen** on the train. — У неё в поезде украли сумку. > He **had his licence taken away**. — У него отобрали права.
Исполнителя обычно не называют; если нужно — добавляем **by**: *We had the report checked **by a lawyer**.* Сравните: *I cut my hair* = я сам(а); *I had my hair cut* = мне подстригли.

## Get something done
**Get** — разговорный вариант, и у него есть дополнительные значения:
- услуга (как с have): *I need to **get my laptop fixed**.*
- **успеть, сделать самому**: *I'll **get the report finished** by Friday.* — Я закончу отчёт к пятнице. *We can't **get anything done** in this noise.* — В таком шуме ничего не сделаешь.
- неприятность (чаще с частями тела): *He **got his fingers caught** in the door.*
> She finally **got the visa approved**. — Ей наконец одобрили визу.
Отдельный смысл у **won't have**: *I **won't have** you talking to me like that.* — Я не позволю (не потерплю), чтобы ты так со мной разговаривал.

## Формы и порядок слов
Конструкция меняется по временам как обычный have: *I'm having it done, I've had it done, I'll have it done, I need to have it done.* В вопросах и отрицаниях в этом значении ставим **do**: *Did you **have** your teeth checked? Do you **have** it serviced every year?* (~~Had you your eyes tested?~~).
Другие модели:
- **have + человек + bare infinitive** (формально/AmE, «поручить»): *I'll **have my assistant send** you the file.* Разговорное: **get + человек + to-infinitive**: *I'll **get my assistant to send** it.*
- **have + объект + -ing** (вызвать длительное действие): *He **had us laughing** all evening.*

## Want / need / like / prefer + объект + V3
Если нужен результат, но неважно, кто его достигнет, используют **want / need / would like / prefer + объект + V3**:
> I **want** this report **finished** by noon. — Хочу, чтобы отчёт был готов к полудню.
> We'd **like** the room **cleaned** before check-in. — Мы бы хотели, чтобы номер убрали до заселения.
> How do you **like** your steak **cooked**? — Как вам приготовить стейк?
Вариант с **to be done** тоже верен (*I want it to be done*). У **need** есть вариант с -ing: *The car **needs washing** = needs to be washed.*
Формально: *I want it **clearly understood** that this is final.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have repaired my car~~ (если ремонтировали вам) → I **have had** my car **repaired**.
- ~~I had my passport to be renewed.~~ → I had my passport **renewed**.
- ~~I'll get repaired my watch.~~ → I'll get **my watch repaired**.
- ~~Had you your eyes tested?~~ → **Have you had** your eyes tested?
- ~~We want the work be finished.~~ → We want the work **finished / to be finished**.
en:
## Have something done: a service or a misfortune
The pattern **have + object + past participle** describes an action carried out by **someone else**, not by the subject. It can mean:
- **a service** (we arrange or pay for it): > We're **having the roof repaired**. > Where do you **have your hair cut**?
- **an unpleasant event** (something happens to you): > She **had her bag stolen** on the train. > He **had his licence taken away**.
The doer is normally not mentioned; if it matters we add **by**: *We had the report checked **by a lawyer**.* Compare: *I cut my hair* (I did it) and *I had my hair cut* (someone did it for me).

## Get something done
**Get** is more informal and has extra meanings:
- a service, like have: *I need to **get my laptop fixed**.*
- **managing to do something**: *I'll **get the report finished** by Friday. We can't **get anything done** in this noise.*
- an accident, often with body parts: *He **got his fingers caught** in the door.*
> She finally **got the visa approved**.
**Won't have** has its own meaning: *I **won't have** you talking to me like that.* (= I will not allow it)

## Forms and word order
The pattern follows the normal tenses of have: *I'm having it done, I've had it done, I'll have it done, I need to have it done.* Questions and negatives use **do**: *Did you **have** your teeth checked?* (~~Had you your eyes tested?~~).
Other patterns:
- **have + person + bare infinitive** (formal/AmE, "arrange for"): *I'll **have my assistant send** you the file.* Informal: **get + person + to-infinitive**: *I'll **get my assistant to send** it.*
- **have + object + -ing** (cause a continuing action): *He **had us laughing** all evening.*

## Want / need / like / prefer + object + past participle
When we want a result and do not care who produces it, we use **want / need / would like / prefer + object + past participle**:
> I **want** this report **finished** by noon.
> We'd **like** the room **cleaned** before check-in.
> How do you **like** your steak **cooked**?
*To be done* is also correct (*I want it to be done*). **Need** also has an -ing form: *The car **needs washing*** (= needs to be washed).

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have repaired my car~~ (if somebody repaired it for you) → I **have had** my car **repaired**.
- ~~I had my passport to be renewed.~~ → I had my passport **renewed**.
- ~~I'll get repaired my watch.~~ → I'll get **my watch repaired**.
- ~~We want the work be finished.~~ → We want the work **finished / to be finished**.
structure:
## Формулы
| Значение | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| услуга | have + object + V3 | I'm **having my car serviced**. |
| услуга (разг.) | get + object + V3 | I must **get my car serviced**. |
| неприятность | have + object + V3 | She **had her wallet stolen**. |
| успеть сделать | get + object + V3 | I'll **get it finished** today. |
| «не потерплю» | won't have + object + -ing | I **won't have** you **shouting**. |
| поручить | have + person + bare inf | I'll **have him call** you. |
| поручить (разг.) | get + person + to-inf | I'll **get him to call** you. |
| пожелание | want / need / like + object + V3 | I **want** it **done** today. |

## Вопрос и отрицание
| Форма | Пример |
|---|---|
| вопрос | **Did** you **have** your hair cut? |
| отрицание | I **haven't had** the report checked yet. |
| perfect | She **has had** her eyes tested. |
| continuous | We're **getting** the boiler replaced. |

exercises.title: Причастие после have / get
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в форму V3.

items.text: Our neighbours are having a swimming pool {{built}} in their garden.
She had her car {{stolen}} while she was on holiday.
I must get my passport {{renewed}} before the trip.
Have you ever had your portrait {{painted}}?
The company had all its computers {{checked}} for viruses.
He got his phone {{fixed|repaired}} for free.
I'm going to have my hair {{dyed}} red.

exercises.title: Have или get в нужной форме
exercises.instruction: Вставьте have или get в правильной форме.

items.text: I'm {{having|getting}} my kitchen redesigned at the moment.
Last week we {{had|got}} the locks changed.
Where did you {{have|get}} your suit made?
She has {{had}} her ring valued twice.
He couldn't {{get}} anything done because of the noise.
I won't {{have}} anyone telling me what to do.
We'll {{have|get}} the documents delivered by courier.

items.q: I'm not going to cut my hair myself; I'll ___ at the salon.
Did you ___ in the garage, or did you do it yourself?
items.why: Исполнитель — другой человек: **have the tyres changed**.
Неприятность, случившаяся с ней: **had her purse stolen**.

items.q: Mr Kim ___ last week by a security firm.
options: had a new alarm system installed
had installed a new alarm system
installed had a new alarm system

items.q: I got my fingers ___ in the lift doors.
I need this report ___ by tomorrow.
I'll have my secretary ___ you the figures.
The boss wants the figures ___ by noon.
items.why: **want + объект + V3**: wants the figures sent.

items.q: I want you ___ here at eight.
Какое предложение означает, что говорящий мыл машину сам?
items.why: Без have/get действие выполняет сам говорящий.

options: I won't have him talking to me like that.
I won't get him to talk to me.

items.q: How do you want your documents ___?
Have you ___ your flu jab yet?
Would you like your coffee ___ strong?

exercises.title: Перепишите с have / get
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя have или get something done.

items.prompt: A mechanic repaired Tom's car yesterday. → Tom ...
answers: Tom had his car repaired yesterday.
Tom got his car repaired yesterday.
Tom had his car repaired by a mechanic yesterday.
Tom got his car repaired by a mechanic yesterday.

items.prompt: (we / have / our wedding photos / take) — present continuous
answers: We're having our wedding photos taken.
We are having our wedding photos taken.

items.prompt: Somebody broke into Lisa's flat. (have) → Lisa ...
answers: Lisa had her flat broken into.

items.prompt: (you / ever / have / your DNA / test) — вопрос
answers: Have you ever had your DNA tested?
Have you ever gotten your DNA tested?
Have you ever got your DNA tested?

items.prompt: They will deliver the sofa on Monday. → We will have ...
answers: We will have the sofa delivered on Monday.
We'll have the sofa delivered on Monday.

items.prompt: My dentist should check my teeth twice a year. → I should ...
answers: I should have my teeth checked twice a year.
I should get my teeth checked twice a year.
